titles_native.title: 超レア武器を狙っただけなのに先に奪われたのは俺の身体でした

description:
[Handsome Researcher Top ‘Roun’ x Beautiful Bottom with Erectile Dysfunction ‘Seonwoo’]

Roun, the No. 1 player in the MMORPG “Cobalt” known as “Silver-Haired,” and Seonwoo, the No. 2 player known as “Moist Cain,” are famous rivals.

Seonwoo, currently ranked second, comes across an event offering a trial of an erectile dysfunction treatment device that rewards participants with the ancient-grade weapon ‘Titan’ and decides to participate...

*“This isn’t erectile dysfunction treatment—it’s tentacle play!”*

What will become of the two as they meet as a researcher and a test subject...?
